structured.answer: Open a trading account at פסגות and buy ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500 (4D), the pair the page marks "הזול ★". With the page's example (10,000 ₪ now plus 500 ₪ a month for 10 years) that leaves about 86,492 ₪ after fees and tax, in today's money. With my 30,000 it would be more, but I didn't change the field.

A wide range with a minus; it scared me and I didn't get why it's there
